voordelen.h1: What can Lemnion do for your hotel
voordelen.sub: With our roots in hospitality, we understand like no other what a hotel needs. Tailor-made, thinking along and full support. That is what Lemnion stands for.
voordelen.s1p: Every hotel has a unique energy profile. We analyse your consumption, peak moments and growth ambitions. Based on that, we map out exactly what energy needs there are, now and in the future.
voordelen.s2p: Together with you we determine the goal of your energy investment. This can differ per hotel:
voordelen.g1: Generate extra revenue via EV chargers or fast chargers
voordelen.g3: Buy and use cheap energy during grid congestion
voordelen.g4: Store self-generated energy (solar/wind) in a battery
voordelen.g6: Enable future expansion, such as more rooms, outlets or air conditioning
voordelen.s3p: The government makes hundreds of millions of euros available every year for energy investments. We know exactly which schemes (EIA, MIA, Vamil, ISDE, SPRILA) apply to your situation and we handle the full application for you. From subsidy check to payout.
voordelen.s4p: Lemnion thinks along in concrete solutions that have direct impact on your business:
voordelen.m1: Extra revenue via EV chargers · 24/7 income from guests, passers-by and local residents
voordelen.m2: Fast chargers for suppliers · trucks are going electric too; offer charging while they unload
voordelen.m3: Fiscal urgency · from 1 January 2027 extra tax on emitting company cars; EV charging becomes essential
voordelen.m4: Smart tariff control · decide what guests pay per charging session, from free service to a €0.70-0.80 per kWh margin
voordelen.m5: 24/7 monitoring · modular platform with its own ecosystem; all facilities monitored in real time
voordelen.facth2: Extra tax on emitting company cars from 2027
voordelen.factp: From 1 January 2027 extra tax will be levied on company cars with emissions, including petrol, diesel and hybrid drives. This accelerates the switch to electric driving. A well-equipped car park with EV chargers is therefore no longer a luxury, but an essential facility for every hotel.

voordelen.s3x-intro: A few concrete insights from the subsidies page:
voordelen.s3x1: Every charged kWh can generate income through the ERE scheme: roughly €0.10 to €0.13 per kWh (grid power).
voordelen.s3x2: The scheme works retroactively to 1 January 2026: kWh charged before you signed up also count.
voordelen.s3x3: For SMEs and hotels there is no minimum threshold anymore; even a single charge point with a MID meter qualifies.
voordelen.s3x4: Fuel suppliers' obligations rise up to 2030, keeping the revenues stable in the long term.
voordelen.factintro: In our blog of 31 August you can read how this legislation accelerates the growth of electric driving, and what it means for your hotel and for business and private guests with an electric car.
